description: The provided file is an Android Fragment written in Kotlin that implements the home screen for an Android TV app. It sets up a top navigation bar and multiple content rows, each displaying horizontally scrollable content cards, supporting D-pad navigation and accessibility features.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays the main Android TV home screen with top navigation and content rows.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and initializes the binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the top navigation bar and content rails.

methods.name: setupTopNav
methods.description: Configures the top navigation RecyclerView with categories and focus handling.

methods.name: setupContentRails
methods.description: Creates mock content rows and sets up the content RecyclerView.
